generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

codes.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
codes.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to respond. Please try again.
codes.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
codes.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
codes.CONFLICT: This was changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.SERVER_ERROR: The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.
codes.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
